items.title: Presence migration is scoped and idempotent
steps: Run migration twice on a disposable database
items.expected: No foreign migrations; both runs succeed.
items.evidence: Static diff confirms only 20260805120000_user_last_active.ts remains; DDL now uses IF NOT EXISTS.

items.title: Friend-only live presence
items.precondition: Three authenticated users: two mutual friends and one non-friend
steps: Observe profile, inbox, and open thread
items.expected: Mutual friends update once; non-friends receive nothing.
items.notes: Requires an isolated multi-user socket runtime.

items.title: Offline emission survives last-active write failure
steps: Disconnect final socket after grace period
items.expected: Offline event is emitted while the persistence failure is logged.
items.evidence: Static control-flow verification: persistence failure is caught and emitPresenceUpdates always runs.
items.notes: Requires a focused realtime test harness.

items.title: Online profiles hide last-active timestamp
items.expected: isOnline is true and lastActiveAt is null.
items.evidence: Static verification: ProfileService now derives lastActiveAt from isOnline.
